item.title: Novel tracing life of Ahom founder Sui-ka-pha released at Assam Book Fair 2025
item.description: Titled “Chaolung: Patkair Heepare Aru Epaare”, the book is authored by Dhrubajyoti Barman & explores Sukapha’s role in shaping Assamese identity

item.title: Around 50 Koch-Rajbongshi Leaders quit UPPL in Bijni, cite discontent over Sixth Schedule
item.description: The Koch-Rajbongshi leaders expressing dissatisfaction over the party’s stance on tribal recognition and Sixth Schedule issues.

item.title: Indian Army, Assam Rifles hold joint helicopter-borne drill in Arunachal’s Changlang
item.description: The helicopter-borne troop insertion exercise was conducted to test rapid deployment and boost operational readiness in remote terrain.

item.title: Lawyer flags lapses in chargesheet, seeks stronger evidence in Zubeen Garg death probe
item.description: Lawyer A R Bhuyan has raised concerns over lapses in the chargesheet filed in the Zubeen Garg death case, stressing the need for proper evidence collection from Singapore to ensure justice.

item.title: Groups holds demonstrations in Guwahati against violence on Hindus in Bangladesh
item.description: Several Hindu organisations staged a protest outside the Bangladesh Assistant High Commission office in Guwahati against demanding an end to violence against minorities.

item.title: SFI, DYFI, AIDWA protest in Guwahati; blame govt for Karbi Anglong unrest
item.description: The Students’ Federation of India (SFI), Democratic Youth Federation of India (DYFI), and the All India Democratic Women’s Association (AIDWA) on Friday held a joint protest

item.title: Over 2900 minority atrocities reported in Bangladesh since Yunus took charge
item.description: India voices serious concern as over 2,900 incidents of violence against minority communities are reported amid rising extremism and regional security fears.

item.title: Cabinet clears Rs 115 Cr for road projects; approves land, police & revenue reforms
item.description: The Cabinet also amended police and land laws, cleared land for Tirupati Tirumala Devasthanam, and sanctioned pattas for 900 families

item.title: Tripura student dies after racial knife attack in Dehradun, outrage grows
item.description: The death of 24-year-old MBA student from Tripura, Angel Chakma sparked outrage and renewed concerns over the safety of Northeast students across India.
